properties.label_detail_en: Under Ptolemy I "the major political role was still held by Memphis"; Ptolemy II made Alexandria the permanent seat (GHA II pp.189–190). Shown for the whole era; the Memphis phase is a different stage, not drawn.

properties.label_en: Hiera Sycaminos, end of the Dodecaschoenus (reference marker)
properties.label_detail_en: The Dodecaschene, Syene to Hiera Sycaminos (~120 km), "had belonged to the Ptolemies, but the rulers of Meroe … had long since added it to their kingdom" (GHA II p.208). Held only for part of the era; dates of loss not given, hence low.
